name: Disneyland Market House (Starbucks) Bacon, Gouda & Egg Breakfast Sandwich
whyItWorks: Warm artisan roll layered with a fluffy egg frittata, smoked bacon, and melted aged Gouda cheese. Gouda is aged and naturally low in lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bacon, Gouda & Egg sandwich warmed; grab a bottle of water for morning park hydration.
